intended_use: market-independent preseason team-strength fitting and coherent 2026 schedule simulation

findings.finding: The 2022 regular season contains 271 completed games because Buffalo–Cincinnati was canceled and is not imputed.
findings.impact: Holdout season totals use actual completed games rather than forcing a 272nd result.

findings.finding: Historical moneylines are complete for the holdout but their exact venue and timing are not strong enough to label as closing prices.
findings.impact: They are reported as an evaluation-only benchmark and are excluded from promotion requirements and model features.

findings.finding: Current 2026 quarterback and material availability adjustments are not yet sourced.
findings.impact: The forecast can be provisional but cannot be promoted to validated or decision-eligible.
